title: UIAO Overlay Fabric Schema
description: Constrains the application-aware overlay fabric configuration for the `overlay` mission class (UIAO_204, anchored by ADR-066 / ADR-123). Governs (a) the in-boundary token-issuer configuration whose fields UIAO_203 references (token_format, max_token_lifetime_seconds, signing_key_rotation_days), (b) the registry of overlay / SD-WAN / SASE / service-mesh fabric entries, each carrying a token-issuer reference and a posture-source reference, and (c) the typed OverlayTunnel runtime record. UIAO observes and reconciles overlay state; it does not route packets or terminate tunnels (ADR-066 lane discipline).

metadata.description: Optional canonical frontmatter per src/uiao/schemas/metadata-schema.json when this schema governs a registry document.

schema-version.description: Semantic version of this overlay-fabric document schema.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the most recent fabric-config update.

issuer.description: The in-boundary overlay token-issuer configuration. UIAO_203 §4 selects Path A: the issuer runs inside the GCC-Moderate boundary with in-boundary key custody.

token_format.description: Wire format of issued overlay tokens (UIAO_203 §2.2). Symmetric-secret formats are intentionally absent — they are non-conforming.

max_token_lifetime_seconds.description: Canon-declared maximum token lifetime (UIAO_203 §3.1). May be lowered per deployment; never above 300 without a superseding ADR. A token whose exp-iat exceeds this is a DRIFT-OVERLAY P1 finding.

signing_key_rotation_days.description: Issuer signing-key rotation cadence (UIAO_203 §3.3). Overlapping validity windows let in-flight tokens validate across a rotation boundary.

placement.description: Issuer placement. `in-boundary` is Path A (preferred, no boundary exception). `declared-exception` is Path B and requires `exception_ref`.

exception_ref.description: Reference to the gcc-boundary-gap-registry.yaml exception entry authorizing an out-of-boundary (Path B) issuer. Required when placement == declared-exception.

key_custody.description: Identifier of the in-boundary key-management surface holding the issuer signing keys (HSM, in-boundary CA, verified-credential service, or in-boundary SPIFFE/SPIRE).

posture_source_ref.description: Reference to the posture-telemetry conformance adapter supplying the device/application posture axis of token issuance (UIAO_203 §2.1).

fabrics.description: Registry of overlay fabric adapter entries. Order is stable; new entries append.

fabricEntry.description: A single overlay / SD-WAN / SASE / service-mesh fabric the substrate observes and reconciles.

id.description: Stable slug identifier for the fabric entry.

vendor.description: Fabric vendor/product (illustrative; UIAO does not pick a vendor).

mission-class.description: Always `overlay` (the sixth mission class, ADR-123). Distinct from the identity-plane `*_transport` write seams.

token_issuer_ref.description: Reference to the token-issuer this fabric's tunnels are authorized by (UIAO_203).

posture_source_ref.description: Reference to the posture source feeding this fabric's enforcement decisions.

status.description: Lifecycle of the fabric adapter entry.

overlayTunnel.description: The typed OverlayTunnel runtime record (ADR-066 §Decision #3). Tunnels are LEASED, not opened; the lease is bounded by token lifetime. The lease.expires_at <= token.exp invariant is normative in UIAO_204 §4 and enforced at reconciliation, not by JSON Schema.

posture.description: Device/application posture digest at lease time.

certificate_chain.description: Optional certificate chain anchoring the tunnel.
